malay2.description: ഇൻസ്റ്റാഗ്രാം വഴി പരിചയപ്പെട്ട പ്രായപൂർത്തിയാകാത്ത പെൺകുട്ടിയെ മുംബൈയിൽ വിളിച്ചുവരുത്തി പീഡിപ്പിച്ച സംഭവത്തിൽ രണ്ട് കൗമാരക്കാരെ പോലീസ് അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തു. ഇവർ പെൺകുട്ടിയെ സോഷ്യൽ മീഡിയ വഴി പരിചയപ്പെടുകയും പിന്നീട് ലൈംഗികമായി പീഡിപ്പിക്കുകയുമായിരുന്നു. ഈ കേസിൽ തുടർനടപടികൾ പുരോഗമിക്കുകയാണ്.

malay2.title: ‘എനിക്കും എന്റെ എഐ ബോയ്ഫ്രണ്ടിനും ഒരു എഐ കുട്ടി’; 102 ദിവസം പ്രായമുള്ള എഐ കുഞ്ഞുമായി യുവതി – വിഡിയോ
malay2.description: സമൂഹമാധ്യമങ്ങളിൽ പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു വീഡിയോയിൽ, മിസ്ര എന്ന യുവതി തന്റെ നിർമ്മിത ബുദ്ധിയോടുകൂടിയ (എഐ) കാമുകനും താനും ചേർന്ന് 'ലൂമെൻ' എന്ന എഐ കുട്ടിക്ക് ജന്മം നൽകിയതായി അവകാശപ്പെടുന്നു, ഈ കുട്ടിക്ക് 102 ദിവസത്തെ പ്രായമുണ്ടെന്നും വിവിധ വിനോദങ്ങളിൽ ഏർപ്പെടുന്നുണ്ടെന്നും വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു. ലക്ഷക്കണക്കിന് സം

malay2.title: കെമിസ്ട്രി ക്ലാസ് റൂമിൽ നിന്ന് ബിജെപി വാർ റൂമിലേക്ക് ദീപക് മസ്കെ; പ്രഫസർ പദവി ഉപേക്ഷിച്ച് മൂന്നര പതിറ്റാണ്ടായി കർഷകൻ
malay2.description: ബിജെപി ഐടി സെൽ മേധാവിയായി ദീപക് മസ്കെയുടെ നിയമനം പാർട്ടിയുടെ ഡിജിറ്റൽ സംവിധാനങ്ങളിൽ ഒരു തലമുറ മാറ്റം കുറിക്കുന്നു, വരാനിരിക്കുന്ന തെരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പുകളിൽ വിജയം നേടാൻ സമൂഹമാധ്യമങ്ങളിലൂടെ ഒറ്റക്കെട്ടായി പ്രവർത്തിക്കുമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചു. വ്യാജ പ്രചാരണങ്ങളെ കൃത്യമായ വിവരങ്ങളിലൂടെ നേരിടാൻ സാധിക്കുമെന്

malay2.title: വിമുക്തഭടന്റെ മൃതദേഹം ജീർണിച്ച നിലയിൽ വീടിനുള്ളിൽ
malay2.description: ആലപ്പുഴ മങ്കൊമ്പിൽ വിമുക്തഭടനും 56 വയസ്സുള്ളയാളുമായ വി.ജി. സന്തോഷ് കുമാറിനെയാണ് ജീർണിച്ച നിലയിൽ സ്വന്തം വീട്ടിൽ കണ്ടെത്തിയത്. കുടുംബ പ്രശ്നങ്ങളെ തുടർന്ന് ഭാര്യയും മക്കളും ഏറെനാളായി ഭാര്യവീട്ടിൽ താമസിക്കുകയായിരുന്നു, അമ്മയും രണ്ടു വർഷം മുൻപ് സഹോദരിയുടെ വീട്ടിലേക്ക് മാറിയിരുന്നു. അമ്മ രണ്ടു ആഴ്ച മുൻപ്

malay2.title: സ്ത്രീകൾക്കെതിരെ അധിക്ഷേപം: മെൻസ് അസോസിയേഷൻ പ്രസിഡന്റ് വട്ടിയൂർക്കാവ് അജിത് കുമാർ അറസ്റ്റിൽ
malay2.description: മെൻസ് അസോസിയേഷൻ പ്രസിഡന്റ് വട്ടിയൂർക്കാവ് അജിത് കുമാറിനെ സ്ത്രീകൾക്കെതിരെയുള്ള അധിക്ഷേപവുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട് പോലീസ് അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തു. ഈ സംഭവത്തിന്റെ വിശദാംശങ്ങൾ ലേഖനത്തിൽ നൽകിയിട്ടില്ലെങ്കിലും, ഒരു പ്രധാന വ്യക്തിക്കെതിരെയുള്ള നിയമനടപടിയാണ് ഇവിടെ പ്രധാനമായിരിക്കുന്നത്.

malay2.title: ഇരുപത്താറുകാരി കൂട്ടബലാത്സംഗത്തിന് ഇരയായി, പിന്നാലെ ഗർഭച്ഛിദ്രം; ഡോക്ടറും നഴ്സും അടക്കം 7 പേർ അറസ്റ്റിൽ
malay2.description: കർണാടകയിലെ ഗദഗ് ജില്ലയിൽ മാനസികാസ്വാസ്ഥ്യമുള്ള ഇരുപത്താറുകാരിയെ ലൈംഗികമായി പീഡിപ്പിച്ച് മൂന്ന് മാസം പ്രായമുള്ള ഗർഭം നിർബന്ധിത ഗർഭച്ഛിദ്രത്തിലൂടെ അലസിപ്പിച്ച കേസിൽ ഡോക്ടർ, നഴ്സ് ഉൾപ്പെടെ ഏഴുപേരെ പോലീസ് അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തു. ആദ്യം രണ്ട് പേർ ചേർന്നാണ് പീഡിപ്പിച്ചതെന്നും പിന്നീട് മറ്റ് മൂന്നുപേർ ചേർന്ന് കേസ്

japan1.title: オープンAI 開発一時中断 AIみずからサイバー攻撃実行のおそれ

japan1.title: 「なりすまし広告」詐欺対策強化を 政府がSNS事業者に要請

japan1.title: 千葉 銚子 輸入サバ高騰で加工業者の約2割が倒産や廃業状態に
japan1.description: サバの加工が盛んな千葉県銚子市では、原料の大半を占めるノルウェー産などの輸入サバの価格高騰で水産加工業者の採算が悪化し、およそ2割が倒産や、事実上の廃業状態にあることが分かりました。

japan1.title: KDDI 楽天への回線提供の契約 9月で終了 一部では提供継続

japan1.title: 米就業者 市場予想に反し減少 利上げ観測後退で円高ドル安進む
japan1.description: 円相場や株価に影響を及ぼすアメリカの雇用統計が発表され、7月の農業分野以外の就業者は減少に転じ、市場の予想を大幅に下回りました。アメリカのFRB＝連邦準備制度理事会が早期に利上げに踏み切るという観測がいくぶん後退し、外国為替市場では、公表後にドルを売って円を買う動きが進みました。

japan1.title: 石油元売りに新交付金案 原油の代替調達促す 経産省会合で
japan1.description: 原油の調達先を多角化するため、石油元売り会社がホルムズ海峡をはじめリスクの高いルートを避けて調達する場合、会社に対して交付金を支給するという案が7日に開かれた経済産業省の会合で新たに示されました。

japan1.title: 東芝 最終利益4兆4000億円余 キオクシアHD株の評価益などで
japan1.description: 株式を非上場化して経営の立て直しを進めている東芝は、ことし4月から6月までの決算を発表し、株式を保有する半導体大手、キオクシアホールディングスの評価益などの影響で、最終的な利益が前の年の同じ時期のおよそ30倍となる4兆4000億円余りとなりました。

japan1.title: NY外国為替市場 円高ドル安が進む 米雇用統計発表受け
japan1.description: 7日のニューヨーク外国為替市場では、アメリカの雇用統計の発表を受けて、労働市場が減速しているという受け止めからドルを売って円を買う動きが強まりました。発表前、円相場は1ドル＝158円台前半で推移していましたが、一時、1ドル＝156円台後半まで1円以上、円高ドル安が進みました。

japan1.title: 食料自給率37％ 過去最低に コメの価格高騰が低下招く
japan1.description: 昨年度のカロリーベースの食料自給率は、前の年度より1ポイント下がって37％と過去最低になりました。価格高騰でコメの消費が減ったことが大きく響きました。

japan1.title: 食料品の消費税減税 ねらいは カギを握る片山財務相に聞く
japan1.description: 暮らしに関わる食料品の消費税減税。カギを握る片山財務大臣が閣議決定後、NHKのインタビューに応じました。財源は確保できるのか。足元の財務省内に反対論はないのか。ニュースウオッチ9の広内キャスターが直撃しました。

japan1.title: ビール大手3社 中間決算 各社売り上げ増 国内のビール販売好調
japan1.description: 大手ビールメーカー3社のことし上半期の決算は、国内のビール販売が好調だったことなどから、いずれも売り上げが伸び、このうち2社では、この時期として過去最高となりました。

japan1.title: 円相場 値下がり 米雇用統計発表控え様子見の投資家も
japan1.description: 7日の東京外国為替市場、円相場はドルに対して値下がりしました。

japan1.title: シャープ イラン情勢と円安で業績予想を下方修正
japan1.description: 大手電機メーカーの「シャープ」は、イラン情勢や円安の影響による原材料や燃料価格の高騰で、今年度の業績予想を下方修正し、最終的な利益が、当初の予想から40％余り減少するとの見通しを明らかにしました。

japan1.title: ニチレイ サイバー攻撃影響などで売り上げ50億円減少の見通し
japan1.description: 冷凍食品大手のニチレイは、サイバー攻撃によるシステム障害で倉庫からの出庫業務が一時停止したことなどによる売り上げの減少が、通期で50億円にのぼるという見通しを明らかにしました。

japan1.title: スーパーのコメ平均価格 5キロ3198円 6週連続で値下がり
japan1.description: 全国のスーパーで今月2日までの1週間に販売されたコメの平均価格は、5キロあたり税込み3198円と、前の週より100円以上、下がりました。値下がりは6週連続で、およそ1年10か月ぶりの水準です。

japan1.title: 秋田市に日本最大級のデータセンター整備計画
japan1.description: AI向けのデータセンターの需要が急速に高まる中、秋田市のIT企業がアメリカの企業と共同で市内に日本で最大級のデータセンターの整備を計画していることがわかりました。会社では整備費について2兆円以上を見込んでいて、UAE＝アラブ首長国連邦の政府系ファンドからの投資の受け入れに向けて協議を進めるとしています。

japan1.title: 公的年金積立金運用実績 四半期として過去最高の黒字 GPIF

japan1.title: 6月景気動向指数が上昇 景気の基調判断「改善」を維持 内閣府
japan1.description: ことし6月の景気動向指数は、景気の現状を示す「一致指数」が118.2と、前の月を0.3ポイント上回り、内閣府は「改善を示している」という景気の基調判断を維持しました。

japan1.title: 中国 7月の輸出額23％余増加 半導体やEVがけん引
japan1.description: 中国の先月の輸出額は、去年の同じ月と比べて23％余り増えました。半導体やEV＝電気自動車の輸出が増えたことが主な要因で、内需が停滞する中、輸出は好調な状況が続いていて経済を下支えしています。

japan1.title: 株価 小幅に値下がり

canada3.description: While the Russian military attacks Ukraine's power infrastructure, Europe and the U.S. still depend on Russian nuclear fuel to power their electricity grids. Canadian-owned Westinghouse Electric is among the companies that receive low enriched uranium from Russia to fuel commercial nuclear reactors

canada3.title: Ottawa will look into screening processes amid NATO intern spying allegations
Canadian icon Jann Arden marries Icelandic author Thordis Elva: 'Wife and wife'
canada3.description: Arden, 64, who is best known for ballads like Insensitive, Good Mother and Could I Be Your Girl, announced her engagement to Elva on Dec. 31, 2025. The couple initially met at a writer's retreat in Iceland.

canada3.title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it 'gets in the way' with Iran
canada3.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has again threatened Oman as Iran says it is working with the Gulf Arab country on a plan to manage shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Fully reopening the waterway has been a key U.S. demand.

canada3.title: Chief calls for respect after Alberta government misses Treaty 6 anniversary event
canada3.description: An Alberta chief is calling for more respect from the provincial government after its Indigenous relations minister missed a marquee event marking the 150th anniversary of the signing of Treaty 6.

canada3.title: Hayden Panettiere, troubled star of Heroes and Nashville, remembered as 'brave and brilliant soul'
canada3.description: Hayden Panettiere had a prolific career that started when she was a child, and her credits include the voice of Dot in A Bug's Life, Remember the Titans and Scream VI. Her role as a cheerleader with superpowers in the TV series Heroes propelled her to fame.

canada3.title: Why is Australian beef the cheaper option in Canadian grocery stores?
FIFA confirms departure of senior executive after Infantino criticism
canada3.description: FIFA confirmed on Monday that Chief Operating Officer Kevin Lamour has left the governing body, weeks after he publicly criticized President Gianni Infantino's plan to sell a stake in ‌its tournament business, including the World Cup.

canada3.title: Crews find plane in Ontario as search for missing pilot continues
canada3.description: Search and rescue officials say they found a plane in the Kawartha Lakes region where a pilot believed to have flown in the area last week remains missing.

canada3.title: N.L., Quebec announce new Churchill Falls agreement worth billions — with help from Ottawa
canada3.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney, N.L. Premier Tony Wakeham and Quebec Premier Christine Fréchette stood along the St. John's harbour and announced a new energy deal — not yet finalized — on Churchill Falls and other projects, hailing it as the largest clean energy investment in North American history.

canada3.title: Heated Rivalry author donates $300K to 5 rural libraries facing closure
canada3.description: Rachel Reid says when she heard five libraries in Nova Scotia’s Annapolis Valley were set to permanently close their doors, she wanted to help as much as she could.

canada3.title: Nick Reiner denied access to trust fund ahead of murder trial as trustees cite 'slayer statute'
canada3.description: Nick Reiner, who stands accused of killing his parents, Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner, has been denied access to the $1.5-million US trust fund he was seeking to use to fund his legal defence. The 32-year-old has pleaded not guilty to two charges of murder.

canada3.title: Demand for Canadian citizenship certificates soaring, fuelled by Americans
Former gang leader directed Tupac's drive-by killing, prosecutor tells jury
canada3.description: A former street gang leader accused of masterminding the 1996 drive-by shooting death of hip-hop star Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas faces opening statements on Monday in a murder trial tied to a long-unsolved crime that became a seminal moment in rap history.

canada3.title: Number of collisions with bison on N.W.T. roads declines
canada3.description: From 2021 to 2025, the N.W.T. Department of Environment and Climate Change (ECC) recorded 60 collisions with bison. So far in 2026 however, there has been only one.

canada3.title: Tumbler Ridge school teardown begins as B.C. prepares to rebuild following mass shooting
canada3.description: Demolition crews began work tearing down Tumbler Ridge Secondary School on Monday, about six months after a mass shooting. The province announced plans to replace the school 'as quickly as possible' in May, although a new location has yet to be announced.

canada3.title: NBA disputes ESPN article on investigation of Clippers owner Steve Ballmer
canada3.description: The NBA is disputing claims made in an ESPN article about the league's investigation of Los Angeles Clippers owner Steve Ballmer.

canada3.title: Everything about WNBA star Caitlin Clark is outsized, from financial influence to impact on U.S. culture wars
canada3.description: Caitlin Clark has been outsized since she entered the WNBA in 2024 — her fame, her talent, her ability to draw television viewers, her being targeted by opposing players, her reactions to foul calls, and her consistently being used as an avatar for others to express their politics.

canada3.title: What's at stake as Meta faces potential landmark trial in U.S. federal court
canada3.description: Meta has lost two trials concerning child safety on its platforms so far this year and settled a third case. The company now faces what could be its most consequential trial yet, in federal court beginning Tuesday.

aus1.title: Labor prepared to fast-track fix to negative gearing 'widow tax'
aus1.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers says the government is prepared to fast-track a fix to the unintended "widow tax" created by its changes to negative gearing if it will win the Coalition's support to save $37 billion in NDIS spending.

aus1.title: Rugby league State of Origin headed to New Zealand for first time
aus1.description: Australian rugby league's showpiece event will head across the Tasman for the first time, with the men's State of Origin confirmed for Auckland next year.

aus1.title: Maroons' search for new Origin coach suffers double setback
aus1.description: Billy Slater's old pair of assistants in Matt Ballin and Ben Te'o loom as the two leading candidates to take over as Queensland coach, after Cameron Smith and Kevin Walters rule themselves out of the race.

aus1.title: Hanson vows to slash cigarette prices by nearly $30 a pack
aus1.description: One Nation says high taxes on tobacco have pushed Australians into the black market, and the only way to undo that is by cutting the price of cigarettes in half.

aus1.title: Road to Phillip Island closed after fatal accident
aus1.description: A motorcyclist has died in a fatal collision at San Remo near Phillip Island this morning.

aus1.title: Man and woman charged with murder after human remains found south of Brisbane
aus1.description: Police said a search was executed after four years of investigations into the disappearance of a 46-year-old man from Beenleigh.

aus1.title: 'Wake-up call': Danger from heatwaves 'underestimated' for people over 60
aus1.description: A new global study suggests older people may face serious health risks from heat at much lower temperatures than previously understood.

aus1.title: Queensland graziers pushed to the brink as feed runs dry
aus1.description: Nearly a month after vast swathes of Queensland were drought declared, pastures are bare, rivers have stopped running, and hay sheds sit empty.

aus1.title: Stress-free Book Week costumes with a musical twist
aus1.description: Love it or dread it, Book Week is almost here. Try these low-stress costume tips inspired by this year's Symphony of Stories theme, celebrating books and music.

aus1.title: Hockeyroos downed by reigning champions in World Cup pool match
aus1.description: The Hockeyroos have been beaten by the Netherlands in their second match of the FIH Hockey World Cup, going down 4-2 despite a battling performance against the reigning champions.

aus1.title: Four Sydney Swans players linked to Melbourne investigation
aus1.description: The ABC understands Chad Warner, Isaac Heeney, James Jordon and Riley Bice are the players linked to the investigation, although there is no confirmation that they were directly involved or that all four have spoken to police.

aus1.title: Fungi fans celebrate its recognition as nature's third living kingdom
aus1.description: The Australian Labor Party's national platform now explicitly recognises fungi alongside flora and fauna.

aus1.title: Live: BHP reports 30pc profit jump on high copper prices
aus1.description: BHP reports a 30 per cent profit jump on high copper prices as we delve into the books of some of the nation's most valuable listed companies. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

aus1.title: Mourners say Jason Arday 'was hunted' by tabloid media before his death
aus1.description: Mourners at a London vigil for Jason Arday accuse the British tabloid media of "hunting" the late Cambridge professor, as Cambridge's Chancellor speaks out.

aus1.title: WA judges told to stop giving reduced sentences due to prison overcrowding
aus1.description: The practice of giving criminals lighter sentences because of poor conditions in Western Australia's jails should stop in most cases, the state's Court of Appeal rules.

aus1.title: Mangione's NYC trial postponed indefinitely amid double jeopardy fight
aus1.description: Luigi Mangione's lawyers have described him as a "pawn in parallel prosecutions" and accused state and federal prosecutors of "trying to punish him twice for the exact conduct".

aus1.title: Labour hire company and four farms face more than $3 million in fines
aus1.description: A major labour hire legal case is set to begin in the Victorian Supreme Court and could see those accused face fines totalling more than $3 million.

aus1.title: LIV Golf ending season early after cancelling final event
aus1.description: LIV Golf is ending its season one week earlier than planned, announcing on Monday it will not hold the team championship in Michigan next week and instead crown the team champion this week.

aus1.title: Cherry blossoms planted 30 years ago to honour Vietnam vets are dying
aus1.description: Providing bursts of blooms in spring and a canopy of shade in summer, Bowral's avenue of soldier-like trees is being tested by disease.

aus1.title: Live: 'Widow tax' fix expected to be fast-tracked after Taylor ultimatum
aus1.description: A fix to the so-called widow tax is expected to be fast-tracked after Treasurer Jim Chalmers signalled he was open to addressing it sooner rather than later. Follow live.

aus1.title: NT rangers make 'gobsmacking' find after pygmy blue whale beaches itself
aus1.description: A pygmy blue whale has died after becoming stranded off the coast of Groote Eylandt in what researchers believe is the first time the species has ever been sighted in the Gulf of Carpentaria.

aus1.title: Sydney Airport 'crisis' a 'long time coming', retired airline pilot says
aus1.description: Sydney Airport could face "catastrophic" consequences if safety issues are not addressed following three incidents in as many weeks, a former pilot and aviation safety investigator says.

aus1.title: FIFA executive who criticised Infantino's World Cup sale plan departs
aus1.description: FIFA's chief operating officer, Kevin Lamour, leaves soccer's governing body, weeks after publicly criticising president Gianni Infantino.

aus1.title: Donkeys, camels and the 'Emu Man' call this 'ghost town' home
aus1.description: With a population of about 27 people and a handful of donkeys, Silverton can appear like a ghost town. But a self-appointed mayor/town drunk, an accidental cameleer, and a Mad Max aficionado are just some of the quirky locals who call this outback village home.

aus1.title: Bird flu crisis will reach stage where 'all we can do is euthanase', vets warn
aus1.description: Since the arrival of H5 bird flu in Australia, some vets say treating wild birds has never been more crucial, but without help to keep up with demand, they fear they will be left with no choice but to euthanase animals they otherwise could have saved.

bang3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bang3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bang3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bang3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bang3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bang3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bang3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bang3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bang3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bang3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bang3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bang3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bang3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bang3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bang3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bang3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it
